mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level (indicating monetary easing) compresses equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals monetary tightening, which increases equity discount rates and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of declining unemployment rate (indicating labor market strength) and rising retail sales (indicating consumer spending) signals robust economic growth, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of UNRATE decline and RSAFS rise does not produce positive returns in >60% of cases, or the interaction term's coefficient is not statistically significant (p>0.05) in a regression over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, elevated CPI index levels (CPIAUCSL > 200) signal persistent inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 200 during monetary tightening cycles, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals a tight labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a broad-based supply contraction, which reduces corporate revenue growth and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in INDPRO and HOUST does not produce negative returns in >60% of cases, or the interaction term is not significant (p>0.05) in a regression over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which supports corporate earnings growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in less than 40% of instances when RSAFS rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 2000.0 thousand units signals a housing market recovery, which boosts construction sector earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in less than 40% of instances when HOUST > 2000.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
